title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: LFVCR (Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression) R package continuous binary outcomes high-dimensional predictors. estimates low-dimensional latent structure, constructs factor--predictor interactions, fits expanded design using cross-validated sparse group lasso.

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: LFVCR implementations follow workflow: Center X without scaling columns. default, estimate GrFA::est_num() using kmax = 15 "IC2" criterion. Alternatively, supply p_hat manually skip automatic estimation. LF_VCR() uses PCA scale. = FALSE. LF_VCR_ae() uses single-hidden-layer H2O autoencoder hidden = p_hat. Construct every predictor--factor interaction. Combine interactions, original predictors, optional covariates. Fit Gaussian binomial sparse group lasso cross-validation. functions use p_hat = NULL default, turns automatic estimation. number.K argument. manually supplied p_hat used directly PCA autoencoder hidden-layer width.

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: package dependencies installed automatically. LF_VCR_ae() also requires Java starts reuses local H2O cluster.

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: examples use simulated data set two latent factors two adjustment covariates. X must numeric matrix observations rows predictors columns. covariate, supplied, must also numeric number rows X.
code: library(LFVCR)  set.seed(42) n <- 120 p <- 24  true_factors <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2), nrow = n) loadings <- matrix(rnorm(p * 2), nrow = p) X <- true_factors %*% t(loadings) +   matrix(rnorm(n * p, sd = 0.35), nrow = n)  covariate <- cbind(   age = rnorm(n),   sex = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5) )

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: Use autoencoder version arguments. p_hat still estimated GrFA::est_num(); becomes autoencoder hidden-layer width.
code: y_continuous <-   1.2 * true_factors[, 1] -   0.7 * true_factors[, 2] +   0.3 * covariate[, "age"] +   rnorm(n)  fit_pca <- LF_VCR(   X = X,   y = y_continuous,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   kmax = 15,   factor_criterion = "IC2" )  fit_pca$p_hat fit_pca$beta fit_ae <- LF_VCR_ae(   X = X,   y = y_continuous,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   kmax = 15,   factor_criterion = "IC2" )  fit_ae$p_hat fit_ae$beta

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: skip GrFA::est_num(), supply p_hat directly. option available functions. p_hat supplied, kmax factor_criterion used. Manual p_hat may zero, case factor extraction interaction terms skipped.
code: fit_pca_manual <- LF_VCR(   X = X,   y = y_continuous,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   p_hat = 2 )  fit_ae_manual <- LF_VCR_ae(   X = X,   y = y_continuous,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   p_hat = 2 )  fit_pca_manual$p_hat_source  # "manual" fit_ae_manual$p_hat_source   # "manual"

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: Set categorical = TRUE supply outcome exactly two observed levels. LFVCR maps first factor level 0 second factor level 1. Set factor levels explicitly positive class matters. binary-outcome call works LF_VCR_ae(): Binary cross-validation folds stratified outcome level.
code: probability <- plogis(   true_factors[, 1] -   0.8 * true_factors[, 2] +   0.2 * covariate[, "sex"] )  y_binary <- factor(   ifelse(rbinom(n, 1, probability) == 1, "case", "control"),   levels = c("control", "case") )  fit_binary <- LF_VCR(   X = X,   y = y_binary,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   kmax = 15,   factor_criterion = "IC2",   categorical = TRUE )  fit_binary$outcome_levels  # "control" is 0; "case" is 1 fit_binary$beta fit_binary_ae <- LF_VCR_ae(   X = X,   y = y_binary,   covariate = covariate,   nfold = 5,   kmax = 15,   factor_criterion = "IC2",   categorical = TRUE )

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: functions return: LF_VCR() additionally returns fitted pca object. LF_VCR_ae() additionally returns fitted H2O autoencoder object. p_hat zero, factor extraction skipped model fitted original predictors optional covariates.

what: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
text: Uses manually supplied factor count estimates GrFA::est_num(), extracts many principal components without scaling predictors, constructs factor--feature interactions, fits expanded design cross-validated sparse group lasso.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
code: LF_VCR(   X,   y,   covariate = NULL,   nfold = 10,   p_hat = NULL,   kmax = 15,   factor_criterion = "IC2",   categorical = FALSE )

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
text: X numeric matrix observations rows predictors columns. y numeric outcome vector one value per row X. covariate optional matrix adjustment covariates. nfold number cross-validation folds used sparsegl::cv.sparsegl(). p_hat Optional nonnegative integer specifying number factors. default, NULL, estimates number GrFA::est_num(). value supplied, automatic factor-number estimation skipped. kmax maximum number factors considered GrFA::est_num() p_hat = NULL. default 15. data fewer dimensions, largest allowable value used. factor_criterion criterion passed GrFA::est_num() estimating p_hat. default "IC2". categorical Logical; use binomial model TRUE Gaussian model FALSE. binary outcome, second factor level modeled 1 levels returned outcome_levels.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
text: list containing selected factor count p_hat, extracted PCA factors, fitted pca object, cross-validated sparse group lasso model, beta coefficients lambda.min, binary outcome_levels applicable. p_hat_source reports whether factor count "estimated" "manual"; kmax_used reports estimation limit.

title: Fit LF-VCR with PCA latent factors — LF_VCR
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ set.seed(1) F <- matrix(rnorm(200), nrow = 100) L <- matrix(rnorm(40), nrow = 20) X <- F %*% t(L) + matrix(rnorm(2000, sd = 0.3), nrow = 100) y <- F[, 1] + rnorm(100) fit <- LF_VCR(X, y, nfold = 5) fit$p_hat fit$beta } # }
